title: Occupational Biomechanics Model Entry
description: Metadata record for one model/method in the Models library: a published method, trained model, or the paper behind an analysis tool. Aligned with schema.org/SoftwareSourceCode and ScholarlyArticle where possible. The library links out; it does not rehost code or weights.

id.description: Unique slug, also the filename. Lowercase, hyphenated.

sample.description: true for placeholder/example entries. Remove or set false for real records.

status.description: released = the paper and/or code is public (default); coming_soon = the method is announced but the paper is not yet published, so no public link exists. Only coming_soon entries may omit links.

links.description: At least one outbound link (required unless status is coming_soon). paper is the canonical landing page (usually the DOI resolver).

paper.description: Canonical paper landing page, usually https://doi.org/...

preprint.description: Open preprint (e.g. arXiv), when the paper is paywalled.

record.description: Institutional record, e.g. a CDC STACKS page.

website.description: Vendor or project page when the method is available as software (commercial or free).

code_license.description: SPDX-style license of the released code, e.g. MIT. Omit when no code is released.

domain.description: Occupational context the model was built for, e.g. 'Residential roofing'.

inputs.description: What the model consumes, e.g. 'Multi-view RGB images'.

outputs.description: What the model produces, e.g. 'Whole-body joint angles'.

related_datasets.description: ids of catalog datasets this model was trained on or is otherwise tied to.
